clips.title: The story
paras: In eastern Elwynn, Guard Thomas sends word of two dead guards and rising danger. He asks you to carry the report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire, where the garrison has few hands to spare.

Guard Thomas watches the bridges into eastern Elwynn, where river traffic meets the wilderness. Guards Malakai and Rolf have been killed by aggressive murloc tribes. With his remaining guards too few to contain them, Thomas sends you down the road to Goldshire with an urgent report.

Marshal Dughan receives Thomas' report in Goldshire, already struggling to keep patrols on the roads. Kobolds infest the area, Defias bandits threaten travelers, and Stormwind City has sent no reinforcements. The deaths of two experienced guards add to his burden. Murlocs may soon threaten Goldshire itself, while the defenses across the region grow ever thinner.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Tell Marshal Dughan of Malakai and Rolf's deaths, and report to him that the Murlocs in eastern Elwynn cannot be contained by our current troop presence.
I know we don't have many troops to spare, but hopefully Dughan can find someone.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm, this news is troubling. Already our defenses are stretched thin, and losing Rolf and Malakai to those murlocs put us in an even worse position.
If things don't improve, there will be fighting in Goldshire by the week's end!
